hebrewText: וְ/כָל עֶרְכְּ/ךָ֔ יִהְיֶ֖ה בְּ/שֶׁ֣קֶל הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֥ה הַ/שָּֽׁקֶל

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)

tokens.kjv: equal, estimation, (things that are set in) order, price, proportion, [idiom] set at, suit, taxation, [idiom] valuest.
